text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Had Laju (Persimpangan

Bertingkat Southville City) 2018.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 10 April 2018.

Larangan

2. (1) Pemanduan suatu kenderaan motor dengan kelajuan yang melebihi

lima puluh kilometer sejam (50 km/j) di atas jalan yang dinyatakan dalam

Jadual Pertama dilarang.

 (2) Jalan dengan had laju yang dinyatakan dalam subperenggan (1)

ditunjukkan dalam peta dalam Jadual Kedua.

JADUAL PERTAMA

Bahagian jalan yang dikenali sebagai Persimpangan Bertingkat Southville City yang

merupakan sebahagian daripada Lebuh Raya Utara Selatan yang bermula dari—

(a) kilometer 293.418 di koordinat U 321776.554, T 418833.151 Grid Bentuk

Benar Serong di Tepi (RSO) Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di koordinat

U 322113.024, T 418028.024 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000);

(b) koordinat U 322044.058, T 417969.629 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000)

dan berakhir di kilometer 294.791 di koordinat U 322796.367, T 417743.540

Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000);

(c) kilometer 294.918 di koordinat U 322913.559, T 417921.267 Grid RSO

Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan berakhir di koordinat U 322113.024,

T 418028.024 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000);

(d) koordinat U 322044.058, T 417969.629 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan

berakhir di kilometer 293.492 di koordinat U 321860.827, T 418634.170

Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000); dan

(e) koordinat U 322113.024, T 418028.024 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000) dan

berakhir di Had Sempadan Penyenggaraan (HSP) di koordinat

U 321443.920, T 418411.782 Grid RSO Geosentrik (GDM 2000).

Dibuat 6 April 2018

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1 Jld.19; PN(PU2)460/XCVI]

ROAD TRANSPORT ACT 1987

SPEED LIMIT (SOUTHVILLE CITY INTERCHANGE) ORDER 2018

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 69(2) of the Road Transport

Act 1987 [Act 333], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Speed Limit (Southville City Interchange)

Order 2018.

 (2) This Order comes into operation on 10 April 2018.

Prohibition

2. (1) The driving of a motor vehicle at a speed exceeding fifty kilometres

per hour (50 km/h) on the road specified in the First Schedule is prohibited.

(2) The road with speed limit as specified in subparagraph (1) is shown

on the map in the Second Schedule.

FIRST SCHEDULE

The part of the road known as the Southville City Interchange which is part of

the North South Expressway comencing from—

(a) kilometre 293.418 at coordinates N 321776.554, E 418833.151 of the Rectified

Skew Orthomorphic (RSO) Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at

coordinates N 322113.024, E 418028.024 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000)

Grid;

(b) coordinates N 322044.058, E 417969.629 of the RSO Geosentric (GDM 2000)

Grid and ending at kilometre 294.791 at coordinates N 322796.367,

E 417743.540 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid;

(c) kilometre 294.918 at coordinates N 322913.559, E 417921.267 of

the RSO Geosentric (GDM 2000) Grid and ending at coordinates N 322113.024,

E 418028.024 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid;

(d) coordinates N 322044.058, E 417969.629 of the RSO Geosentric (GDM 2000)

Grid and ending at kilometre 293.492 at coordinates N 321860.827,

E 418634.170 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid; and

(e) coordinates N 322113.024, E 418028.024 of the RSO Geosentric (GDM 2000)

Grid and ending at Limit of Maintenance Responsibility (LMR) at coordinates

N 321443.920, E 418411.782 of the RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid.

Made 6 April 2018

[KKR.PUU.110-1/7/1 Jld.19; PN(PU2)460/XCVI]

DATO' SRI HAJI FADILLAH BIN HAJI YUSOF
